title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Event - ECMRCarrierModifiedEvent
description: An event in the eCMR document lifecycle recording that the carrier modified the document. (simple-ev:ECMRCarrierModifiedEvent, SIMPLE extension to the FEDeRATED Event ontology, subclass of Event:AtomicEvent, itself a subclass of Event:Event).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ECMRCarrierModifiedEvent'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasTimestamp.description: Property. Event:hasTimestamp (inherited from Event). The timestamp associated with this event. A timestamp modifier is given via hasDateTimeType.

hasDateTimeType.description: Property. Event:hasDateTimeType (inherited from Event). Whether hasTimestamp is an actual, estimated, expected, planned or requested date-time. Modeled as an enum: the base ontology declares exactly these five named individuals of Event:DateTimeType.

hasMilestone.description: Property. Event:hasMilestone (inherited from Event). Whether this event marks the Start or End of the activity it represents. Modeled as an enum: the base ontology declares exactly these two named individuals of Event:Milestone.

hasSubmissionTimestamp.description: Property. Event:hasSubmissionTimestamp (inherited from Event). The date-time at which this event was submitted.

involves.description: Relationship. Event:involves (inherited from Event). Generic association between this event and a digital twin, business transaction, location or logistics actor; the source ontology's own subproperties (involvesBusinessTransaction, involvesDigitalTwin, involvesPhysicalInfrastructure, below) give the specific meaning -- this generic property is documented for completeness but not expected to be used directly. Range: owl:Thing.

involvesBusinessTransaction.description: Relationship. Event:involvesBusinessTransaction (inherited from Event, subPropertyOf involves). The business transaction this event is associated with. Range: businessService:BusinessTransaction -- modeled as CargoHandlingOrder / DischargeOrder / GateInOrder / GateOutOrder / ShuntingOrder / Consignment / Shipment / TransportService / CargoHandlingService in the sibling simple-federated-businessservice candidate (out of scope of this candidate).

involvesDigitalTwin.description: Relationship. Event:involvesDigitalTwin (inherited from Event, subPropertyOf involves). The digital twin (e.g. a TransportMeans, Equipment or Goods instance) this event is associated with. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject -- out of scope of this candidate, see the sibling simple-federated-digitaltwin candidate.

involvesPhysicalInfrastructure.description: Relationship. Event:involvesPhysicalInfrastructure (inherited from Event, subPropertyOf involves). The location/physical infrastructure this event is associated with. Range: geo:SpatialThing -- out of scope of this candidate, see the sibling simple-federated-physicalinfrastructure candidate.
